items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: Chick had Ella, we had Billie... Then by that time Ella Fitzgerald come up and you knew about Ella, that did the thing with Benny Goodman.

ctx.x: In 1937, January 1937. Yes I have tapes and I have pictures because Chick had Ella, we had Billie. And everybody - the dancers - everybody was looking.....
